panels.description: Pincha para mover el origen. Dale al play de la barra inferior: el reloj marca la hora del viaje, 07:00 es la salida. Al pausar, los tres números de abajo se recolocan en ese instante.

targets.rawSql:
-- Cobertura por bandas de 5 min, sin filtrar por el reloj: la sombra.
SELECT minutos, ST_AsHEXWKB(geom) AS geom
FROM ST_Read('http://172.22.0.1:8099/iso.geojson?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&step=5&max=' || $cutoff);

-- Una fila por celda alcanzable, con el minuto en que se alcanza
-- convertido a hora de reloj desde la salida (07:00).
SELECT minutos, geom,
       (($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP
        + INTERVAL (minutos) MINUTE) AS t
FROM read_json_auto('http://172.22.0.1:8099/cells.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&max=' || $cutoff);

targets.rawSql:
SELECT personas FROM read_json_auto('http://172.22.0.1:8099/accessibility.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos) WHERE minutos = least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
                 try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)),
               try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),
      try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER));

panels.title: Población

panels.description: Paradas de los feeds cuya celda se alcanza dentro del umbral. Sigue al reloj del mapa: pausa la animación donde quieras y el número se recoloca ahí. Antes del primer play muestra el corte.

targets.rawSql:
WITH alcance AS (
  SELECT min(c.minutos) AS m
  FROM (SELECT unnest(stops) AS s FROM read_json_auto('https://r5.ubica.ec/api/gtfs/6a976415196cd834c785ad5d/stops')) p
  JOIN (SELECT minutos, ST_GeomFromHEXWKB(geom) AS g
        FROM read_json_auto('http://172.22.0.1:8099/cells.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&max=' || $cutoff)) c
    ON ST_Within(ST_Point(p.s.lon, p.s.lat), c.g)
  GROUP BY p.s._id
)
SELECT count(*) AS paradas FROM alcance WHERE m <= least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
                 try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)),
               try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),
      try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER));

panels.title: Paradas

panels.description: Parques con algún acceso dentro del umbral, de 381 existentes. Se cuenta el parque, no la puerta. Sigue al reloj del mapa: pausa la animación donde quieras y el número se recoloca ahí. Antes del primer play muestra el corte.

targets.rawSql:
WITH parques AS (
  SELECT p.park_id, min(c.minutos) AS m
  FROM ST_Read('https://appsllactalab.ucuenca.edu.ec/geoserver/geonode/puntos_acceso_parques/ows?service=WFS&version=2.0.0&request=GetFeature&typeNames=geonode:puntos_acceso_parques&outputFormat=application/json&srsName=EPSG:4326') p
  JOIN (SELECT minutos, ST_GeomFromHEXWKB(geom) AS g
        FROM read_json_auto('http://172.22.0.1:8099/cells.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&max=' || $cutoff)) c
    ON ST_Within(p.geom, c.g)
  WHERE p.situacion IS DISTINCT FROM 'RESERVA'
  GROUP BY p.park_id
)
SELECT count(*) AS parques FROM parques WHERE m <= least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
                 try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)),
               try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),
      try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER));

panels.title: Parques

panels.description: Suma del área real de las celdas alcanzadas. Sigue al reloj del mapa: pausa la animación donde quieras y el número se recoloca ahí. Antes del primer play muestra el corte.

targets.rawSql:
WITH celdas AS (
  SELECT minutos,
         ST_Area(ST_Transform(ST_GeomFromHEXWKB(geom), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857',
                              always_xy := true))
           / 1e6 * pow(cos(radians(try_cast($lat AS DOUBLE))), 2) AS km2
  FROM read_json_auto('http://172.22.0.1:8099/cells.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&max=' || $cutoff)
)
SELECT round(sum(km2), 1) AS km2 FROM celdas WHERE minutos <= least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
                 try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)),
               try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),
      try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER));

panels.title: Superficie

panels.description: Acumulada, de 5 en 5 minutos hasta el corte. El punto rojo es dónde va el reloj del mapa.

targets.rawSql:
WITH marcas AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m FROM (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(0, try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER), 5)) AS m
    UNION ALL SELECT least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
                 try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)),
               try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),
      try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER))
  ) WHERE m BETWEEN 0 AND try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT marcas.m AS minutos, a.personas,
       CASE WHEN marcas.m = least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
                 try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)),
               try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),
      try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)) THEN a.personas END AS "en el reloj"
FROM marcas JOIN read_json_auto('http://172.22.0.1:8099/accessibility.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos) a ON a.minutos = marcas.m
ORDER BY marcas.m;

panels.title: Población alcanzable

panels.description: Acumuladas, de 5 en 5 minutos hasta el corte. El punto rojo es dónde va el reloj del mapa.

targets.rawSql:
WITH alcance AS (
  SELECT min(c.minutos) AS m
  FROM (SELECT unnest(stops) AS s FROM read_json_auto('https://r5.ubica.ec/api/gtfs/6a976415196cd834c785ad5d/stops')) p
  JOIN (SELECT minutos, ST_GeomFromHEXWKB(geom) AS g
        FROM read_json_auto('http://172.22.0.1:8099/cells.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&max=' || $cutoff)) c
    ON ST_Within(ST_Point(p.s.lon, p.s.lat), c.g)
  GROUP BY p.s._id
),
marcas AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m FROM (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(0, try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER), 5)) AS m
    UNION ALL SELECT least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
                 try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)),
               try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),
      try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER))
  ) WHERE m BETWEEN 0 AND try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT marcas.m AS minutos,
       count(alcance.m) AS paradas,
       CASE WHEN marcas.m = least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
                 try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)),
               try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),
      try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)) THEN count(alcance.m) END AS "en el reloj"
FROM marcas LEFT JOIN alcance ON alcance.m <= marcas.m
GROUP BY marcas.m ORDER BY marcas.m;
